bounds.note: Everything inside except the water plane polygon

facadeStyles.br1: red brick pre-war walk-up (cornice, fire escapes)
facadeStyles.mx: mixed: masonry base + metal panel upper

zones.desc: Glass/concrete office core around Stark Blvd x Howard Ave; all 25+ floor towers; Legacy Tower block
Mixed-use 4-20 floors between Keener Ave and Carbonell Ave; relay tower; hospital
Brick walk-ups and row houses (2-6 floors, water towers, stoops) west and north
Lofts, warehouses and sheds south of Expo Parkway; loading docks
Harbor Drive frontage, promenade, seawall and piers (ferry, Stark Marine Bay, marina, capacitor dock)
Lakeview Park superblock (lawn, pond, tree clusters)
Stark Expo ruins + scorched battle field by the south-east harbor

battlefield.note: Scorched field: ruins-zone harbor blocks east of the Expo
